blogPosts.title: How Much Does Landscape Design Cost in Melbourne's Bayside?
blogPosts.excerpt: Planning a landscape project in Bayside? We break down the real costs of landscape design across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, and surrounding suburbs.
body: Understanding landscape design costs in Melbourne's Bayside begins with the unique factors that affect pricing in this premium coastal region. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, we have completed hundreds of projects across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, and Sandringham over the past decade, giving us clear insight into Bayside pricing. A comprehensive landscape design typically ranges from $5,000 for a simple garden renovation to $50,000 or more for a full outdoor transformation. The main cost drivers include your property size, design complexity, material selection, and any specialist requirements like retaining walls or pool landscaping.

One of the biggest cost drivers for Bayside landscaping is the choice of hardscape materials. Pavers, natural stone, and exposed aggregate concrete each carry different price points, and Bayside's proximity to the coast means we often recommend materials rated for salt-air exposure. Premium porcelain pavers suitable for Mentone's modern homes typically cost between $80 and $150 per square metre installed. Concrete paving is more budget-friendly at $50 to $90 per square metre, while natural stone like bluestone — a favourite across Brighton and Hampton — can range from $100 to $200 per square metre.

Labour costs represent a significant portion of any Bayside landscaping budget. Qualified landscapers in Melbourne typically charge between $55 and $90 per hour, though specialist trades such as concreters or electricians for outdoor lighting may command higher rates. For a typical Bayside residential project, expect labour to represent roughly 40 to 60 percent of your total investment. Our team at Paradise Paving Landscaping provides fixed-price quotes before any work begins, so you will never face unexpected costs mid-project.

Council regulations can also influence your landscape design costs, particularly in Bayside's established suburbs. Brighton, Beaumaris, and Black Rock often have heritage overlays or vegetation protection orders that affect what you can remove or install. A landscape design consultant familiar with the City of Bayside's planning scheme can save you thousands by identifying potential compliance issues early. Replacing established trees in Hampton may require a permit, while pool fencing in Sandringham must comply with strict Victorian safety regulations.

The type of outdoor space you are creating dramatically affects your final investment. A simple front garden renovation in Mentone with new turf, garden edging, and basic planting might cost between $3,000 and $8,000. Add a paved entertaining area and you are looking at $10,000 to $25,000 depending on materials and size. Full backyard transformations — including deck construction, pool landscaping, retaining walls, and professional planting — regularly exceed $40,000 for Bayside properties.

To get the best value from your Bayside landscape investment, we recommend starting with a professional consultation. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, our free on-site assessments across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, and surrounding suburbs include a thorough evaluation of your soil conditions, drainage, sun exposure, and council requirements. We then provide a detailed, itemised quote with no hidden costs. Our decade of Bayside experience means we know which plants thrive in Melbourne's coastal microclimate, which paving materials withstand salt air, and how to maximise your outdoor living potential.

Contact Paradise Paving Landscaping today on 0419 528 817 to discuss your Bayside landscaping project. Whether you are in Mentone, Kingston, Frankston, or anywhere across Melbourne's Bayside, we will provide expert guidance tailored to your property and budget. Discover how affordable your dream outdoor space really is with a free, no-obligation consultation from Bayside's trusted landscaping team.

blogPosts.title: Best Pool Landscaping Ideas for Bayside Homes in 2026
blogPosts.excerpt: Transform your Bayside pool area with these stunning landscaping ideas. From paving to planting, discover what works best in Melbourne's coastal climate.
body: Melbourne's Bayside is home to some of Victoria's most stunning residential pools, and the right landscaping can transform a basic pool area into a resort-style retreat. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, we have designed and built pool landscapes across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, and Sandringham for over a decade, and we have seen firsthand how thoughtful design elevates both aesthetics and functionality. The best pool landscaping in Bayside considers Melbourne's coastal climate — salt-laden winds, intense summer UV, and cool winters — while complementing the architectural style of your home.

Natural stone paving remains the gold standard for Bayside pool surrounds, and for good reason. Materials like bluestone, travertine, and sandstone offer timeless beauty with excellent slip resistance — critical for wet pool areas. In Brighton and Hampton, we are seeing a strong trend toward large-format bluestone pavers that create a seamless, modern look extending from the pool edge to the outdoor entertaining area. Travertine is particularly popular in Beaumaris and Black Rock where the lighter tones complement coastal architecture and reflect Melbourne's bright summer sun.

Poolside planting is where Bayside properties truly shine. The coastal microclimate between Mentone and Frankston supports a surprisingly diverse palette of pool-friendly plants. We recommend hardy, salt-tolerant species like agave, lomandra, and native grasses that thrive in Melbourne's bayside conditions with minimal maintenance. For a tropical feel in your Kingston or Aspendale garden, ornamental grasses, bird of paradise, and yuccas create lush screening without dropping excessive debris into your pool.

Outdoor lighting is an often-overlooked element of pool landscaping that dramatically enhances your Bayside property's night-time appeal and safety. LED strip lighting along pool edges, underwater fixtures, and uplighting on feature trees create a magical evening atmosphere perfect for entertaining. In Melbourne's Bayside, where outdoor entertaining extends well into autumn, quality lighting doubles the usable hours of your pool area.

Decking around pools continues to be a top request from our Bayside clients, particularly in suburbs like Sandringham and Black Rock where elevated blocks offer the opportunity for multi-level outdoor spaces. Composite decking materials have become increasingly popular for pool surrounds because they resist the moisture damage that traditionally plagued timber. For a more natural aesthetic, hardwood options like spotted gum and blackbutt offer warmth and character.

When planning your Bayside pool landscape, budgeting realistically ensures you achieve the look you want without compromise. A basic pool landscape upgrade with new paving and planting typically starts around $15,000, while a complete pool environment transformation — including paving, decking, planting, fencing, and lighting — generally ranges from $35,000 to $80,000. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, we provide transparent, itemised quotes for every Bayside pool project. Contact us on 0419 528 817 to schedule your free pool landscaping consultation across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, and all Bayside suburbs.

blogPosts.title: Paving vs Synthetic Turf: Which Is Right for Your Bayside Garden?
blogPosts.excerpt: Choosing between paving and synthetic turf for your Bayside property? We compare costs, durability, maintenance, and climate suitability for Melbourne.
body: Choosing between paving and synthetic turf is one of the most common decisions Bayside homeowners face when renovating their outdoor spaces. Both options offer distinct advantages for Melbourne's coastal climate, and the right choice depends on how you use your garden, your maintenance preferences, and the specific conditions of your Bayside property. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, we have installed thousands of square metres of both paving and synthetic turf across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, and surrounding suburbs, giving us deep insight into what works best in different situations.

Paving excels in high-traffic entertaining areas and is the preferred choice for most Bayside outdoor living spaces. Whether you choose concrete pavers, natural stone, or porcelain, a well-installed paved area provides a durable, low-maintenance surface that handles furniture, foot traffic, and Melbourne's unpredictable weather without issue. For Mentone and Brighton homeowners who love outdoor dining and entertaining, paving around the barbecue and seating area is a practical, long-lasting solution.

Synthetic turf has revolutionised how Bayside homeowners approach their lawns, particularly in areas where maintaining natural grass is challenging. Melbourne's hot, dry summers and Bayside's sandy or clay-heavy soils in suburbs like Kingston and Aspendale can make natural turf high-maintenance and water-hungry. Modern synthetic grass looks remarkably realistic, with multi-toned fibres and a natural pile that is virtually indistinguishable from the real thing.

Climate considerations heavily influence whether paving or synthetic turf suits your Bayside property. Melbourne's Bayside experiences a temperate oceanic climate with cool winters, warm summers, and rainfall spread fairly evenly throughout the year. Paving handles this climate exceptionally well — it drains quickly after rain, does not become waterlogged, and requires virtually no maintenance beyond occasional cleaning.

The visual impact of your choice matters enormously in Bayside's leafy, design-conscious suburbs. Paving offers endless design possibilities — from the classic elegance of bluestone in Brighton's heritage properties to the contemporary clean lines of porcelain pavers in modern Hampton homes. Synthetic turf, on the other hand, delivers a lush, green canvas that softens hardscaped areas.

Ultimately, the best approach for most Bayside properties combines both paving and synthetic turf to maximise functionality and visual appeal. A well-designed Bayside garden typically features paved entertaining areas, synthetic or natural turf for green space, and strategically placed garden beds for colour and texture. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, we specialise in creating balanced outdoor designs that integrate hardscaping and softscaping harmoniously across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, Sandringham, and all Bayside suburbs. Call us on 0419 528 817 to discuss whether paving, synthetic turf, or a combination of both is the right solution for your Bayside garden.

blogPosts.title: The Complete Guide to Fencing for Your Mentone Property
blogPosts.excerpt: Looking for the right fence for your Mentone home? We cover materials, costs, council regulations, and the best options for Bayside's coastal conditions.
body: Choosing the right fence for your Mentone property involves much more than picking a style you like. As a Bayside suburb with a mix of heritage and modern homes, Mentone has specific council requirements, neighbourhood aesthetics, and environmental factors that influence your fencing options. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, we have installed fencing across Mentone, Brighton, Hampton, Kingston, and surrounding Bayside suburbs for over a decade, and we understand exactly what works in this region.

Timber fencing remains a popular choice in Mentone and across the Bayside area, offering warmth, natural beauty, and excellent privacy. Treated pine is the most affordable timber option, typically costing $75 to $120 per linear metre installed, making it ideal for long boundary fences. For a premium look, hardwood options like merbau or spotted gum provide superior durability and a richer appearance, ranging from $120 to $200 per linear metre.

Colorbond fencing has become increasingly popular across Mentone and the broader Bayside area for its durability, low maintenance, and clean modern lines. Available in a wide range of colours to complement your home, Colorbond steel fencing resists rust, fading, and damage from Bayside's salt-laden winds — a significant advantage for properties closer to the coast in Brighton, Hampton, and Sandringham.

Pool fencing is a legal requirement for any Mentone property with a swimming pool, and Victorian regulations are strict. All pool barriers must comply with Australian Standard AS 1926.1, which specifies minimum heights, self-closing gates, and child-resistant latch mechanisms. Glass pool fencing has become the preferred choice in Bayside's premium suburbs, offering unobstructed pool views while meeting all safety requirements.

The City of Bayside has specific planning requirements that affect fencing in suburbs like Mentone, Brighton, and Beaumaris. Front fence heights are generally limited to one metre, while side and rear boundary fences can typically be up to two metres — though heritage overlays in areas like Brighton may impose stricter conditions. Before installing any fence, check with Bayside City Council or have your landscaping professional handle the permit process.

For Mentone homeowners looking for fencing that balances aesthetics, durability, and value, a professional consultation is the ideal starting point. At Paradise Paving Landscaping, we assess your property's specific needs — from soil conditions and wind exposure to council regulations and neighbouring property considerations — before recommending the best fencing solution. Call 0419 528 817 to discuss your Mentone fencing project or visit our website for examples of our recent Bayside fencing installations.
